signals.text: Who produced the kind of performance Moyes loves? - player ratings. Newcastle United and Everton's players rated following their Premier League match.

'He's unavailable' - Moyes tight-lipped on Grealish. Everton manager David Moyes' post-match reaction to his side's one-goal win against struggling Newcastle United, as well as the availability of Jack Grealish following disciplinary action.
Why Scottish football is struggling to produce young talent. Scottish football is wrestling with a growing concern over the number of homegrown players who are making to the top of the game.
